verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
I said I'd never write these words
Or tell You that I miss You Lord
For it reflects that You are far
When it is me who breaks Your heart

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
All I want is You and all I need
Is found only in Your heart

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
I told You that I hated You
But instead You came to me with love
You said no more to this mountain
You said no more to this mountain
